description: The Global Oil Infrastructure Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, catalogues midstream crude oil and natural gas liquids (NGL) transmission pipelines, with asset-level data and routes for operating and in-development projects worldwide. On 26 September 2026 the page counted 1,634 oil pipeline projects with 487,000 km of length and 292 NGL pipeline projects with 11,100 km. Records give route, length, status, owners and start year, and summary tables give kilometres by country, owner, region and start year. The latest release was March 2025. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the data were last released in March 2025, so recent project changes may be missing. Simulation uses are oil supply network models, pipeline hazard exposure and disruption studies. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
